title: EXP-056 — Hello World Part 3 Section 7: Set Values and Variable-Bound Edit
objective: On the existing User-scoped FX_Items Form, preserve the StdFormRefreshCompleted sequence-0 Hello World Prompt, append exactly one sequence-1 Set Values action that assigns FX_VarTest from the documented or visibly supported Description property expression, and add exactly one Edit component named FX_VarTestEdit bound to Variable FX_VarTest. Verify the intended definition before Save, perform one ordinary Designer Save, close and reopen the Form once, and record variable-definition visibility independently at every lifecycle boundary. Then open the saved Form once in the Web Client, dismiss the expected Hello World Prompt through native OK if present, and determine whether FX_VarTestEdit displays the current record's Description. The primary acceptance postconditions are recovery of the saved handler/action and Edit binding, and the correct runtime value. A missing variable definition after Save or reopen must be reported as an observation, not repaired or automatically treated as an acceptance failure.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, hello-world-pt3.md Section 7 at 06:03–07:39 and its agent boundary, and relevant EXP-004, EXP-014, EXP-054-R2, and EXP-055 evidence before browser mutation.

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight evidence identifies the exact existing FX_Items Form and its User scope, the clean Designer and Web Client, Initial Command Refresh, the single StdFormRefreshCompleted sequence-0 Hello World Prompt, and the three existing item records. Screenshots and snapshots identify the actual selected Form and scope. This is a prerequisite gate.

Before mutation, evidence records the complete inventory and native available properties of all 16 original components, including binding fields, Location, Size, and all exposed Events; the original Variables collection; and the absence of FX_VarTest, FX_VarTestEdit, and a conflicting sequence-1 action. An essential unavailable baseline blocks mutation rather than being invented.

Before Save, the native Event Handlers interface shows the existing StdFormRefreshCompleted handler with precisely two actions: sequence 0 retains the original Hello World Prompt, and sequence 1 has Response Type Set Values with the verified FX_VarTest assignment using the supported Description expression. Actual editable parameters and the committed action row are captured.

Before Save, the Form Variables interface and Set Values Parameters interface are captured separately, showing whether a distinct FX_VarTest definition exists, its configured value where exposed, and the sequence-1 assignment. This establishes the pre-Save observation without conflating variable definitions with Set Values assignment rows.

The Designer contains exactly one new FX_VarTestEdit component, with Type Edit, Binding Type Variable, Binding FX_VarTest, and recorded Location and Size. The 16 original component records and properties match the AC-2 baseline. The UI provides decisive screenshots and property readback.

Exactly one ordinary Designer Save reports native success and leaves Save disabled. Post-Save readback shows the sequence-0 Prompt unchanged, sequence-1 Set Values retained, and FX_VarTestEdit still bound to FX_VarTest. This is a mandatory saved-definition acceptance gate.

Immediately after the single Save, the worker independently records whether FX_VarTest appears in the Variables tab, with its actual observed properties if present or its absence if missing. Either result satisfies this observation-only documentation check. No missing definition is recreated.

Exactly one clean Designer close followed by one native recent-forms reopening recovers the User-scoped FX_Items identity, the original Prompt, the sequence-1 Set Values action, and the FX_VarTestEdit variable binding, with Save disabled and original components matching the pre-mutation baseline. These recovered handler and Edit-binding properties are mandatory acceptance gates.

After Designer reopening, evidence independently records whether FX_VarTest remains visible in the Form Variables collection. Presence or absence is accepted as an observation, not as a retention gate. If absent, the worker does not recreate it, change the handler, or perform another Save.

The Web Client evidence shows one clean FX_Items runtime-tab closure and exactly one native Select Form opening. The immediate and settled states are captured; any expected Hello World Prompt is recorded and, if present, dismissed exactly once with native OK. No opening or refresh is retried.

At settled runtime, the displayed FX_VarTestEdit value is directly observable and exactly matches the Description field of the same currently selected item, for example 45 pound iron for the dumbbell record. A missing Edit, blank value, or mismatched value fails this mandatory runtime-value gate. The screenshot identifies the selected record and Edit value together.

Final runtime evidence shows the original three records unchanged, FX_Refresh still rendered, Save disabled, and the native object indicator recorded when visible. A final acceptance matrix reconciles all actions and prohibited operations, reports the variable-definition state at each of the four checkpoints, distinguishes observed results from inferences, and identifies evidence-file paths and repository-change confinement.

initial_instruction: T1 — READ-ONLY PREFLIGHT ONLY. First read AGENTS.md, hello-world-pt3.md Section 7 (06:03–07:39) and its agent boundary, and the decisive EXP-004, EXP-014, EXP-054-R2 and EXP-055 reports. Call browser_tabs list before the first browser_tabs select. Establish the live DEM Web Client and Designer state, exact FX_Items Name plus User ScopeType and ScopeName, Initial Command Refresh, clean state, original three records, and the existing StdFormRefreshCompleted sequence-0 Hello World Prompt. Inspect Form Variables and verify whether FX_VarTest exists. Capture all 16 existing components, their hierarchy, Name, Type, Caption, Binding Type, Binding, Location, Size, and every exposed Event property, using native visible UI evidence. Confirm no FX_VarTestEdit component and no existing sequence-1 action. Preserve a per-component comparison table with exact screenshot and accessibility evidence under evidence/EXP-056/. If any essential property is inaccessible, collision exists, session is unusable, or the baseline is ambiguous, stop and report the blocker without mutation. Do not open any editing dialog, create a variable, configure Set Values, place an Edit, Save, close/reopen, activate Refresh, or modify runtime. Use at most one fresh snapshot and one corrected inspection for a browser-reference failure. Record proof and limitations in the EXP-056 experiment record and evidence directory, then return for coordinator review. The proposal does not authorize T1 execution until operator approval.
notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261011-153829-vsIH. Rationale: EXP-055 established that the existing User-scoped FX_Items Form can retain a StdFormRefreshCompleted Prompt handler and display Hello World prompts during opening and refresh-button activation. Section 7 introduces the distinct capability of assigning a Form-variable value from an IDO property and displaying that value through a variable-bound Edit component. EXP-004 and EXP-014 show that variable definitions can disappear across Save and close/reopen, so definition retention will be observed separately rather than treated as a prerequisite for runtime success. EXP-055 also revealed that incomplete component baselines can prevent strict acceptance despite successful functionality. EXP-056 therefore requires a full observable pre-mutation component baseline, including bindings, geometry, and events, before permitting any change. This is a new tutorial capability, not a workaround or replay of EXP-055. | Operator review 2026-10-11: narrowed the create/add pattern to custom events only, because the Set Values action is itself a second StdFormRefreshCompleted handler created with New (the core step); added the FormSync/Regenerate/Deploy/Unload and browser-JavaScript patterns; exact_values FX_Items, FX_VarTest, FX_VarTestEdit, P(Description) (case-sensitive typing guard); deny_browser_javascript; User editing scope. Operator decision: no diagnostics. Approved by the operator 2026-10-11 with precondition attestation: logged in, configuration OK, Web Client loaded, no unsaved changes.
